_comment: Smart collections the theme's templates and menus link to — identical handles and rules to the development store. Genus collections match on product type; curated ones on tags. 'metafield' rules match a custom.* metafield value.

collections.title: Venus flytraps
collections.description: Dionaea muscipula — the snap-trap icon. Full sun, rainwater and a cool winter rest are all they ask.

collections.title: Sundews
collections.description: Drosera — glittering sticky tentacles that curl around their prey. Several of the world's easiest sundews are South African.

collections.title: Trumpet pitchers
collections.description: Sarracenia — tall, veined pitchers for sunny patios and bog gardens.

collections.title: Tropical pitchers
collections.description: Nepenthes — hanging pitchers from the tropics, grouped by the climate they need.

collections.title: Butterworts
collections.description: Pinguicula — jewel-like rosettes that quietly clear fungus gnats from a windowsill.

collections.title: Bladderworts
collections.description: Utricularia — tiny underground vacuum traps and flowers that steal the show.

collections.title: Sun pitchers
collections.description: Heliamphora — pitchers from the misty tabletop mountains of South America.

collections.title: Albany pitchers
collections.description: Cephalotus follicularis — tiny, toothy pitchers from south-western Australia.

collections.title: Growing supplies
collections.description: Mineral-free soil, pots and kits — everything a carnivore needs, nothing it doesn't.

collections.title: Beginner-friendly
collections.description: Forgiving, fast-growing carnivores that thrive on a sunny windowsill or patio. The best place to start.

collections.title: Rare species
collections.description: Collector plants and named clones for experienced growers.

collections.title: Tropicals
collections.description: No winter rest needed — warm, humid growers for windowsills and terrariums.
